items.title: Management Raised the Bar For Eli Lilly Stock; Does The Chart Agree?
items.summary: Eli Lilly (LLY) raised its revenue forecast for 2026 on August 5, when it reported second-quarter results. Since the close before that release, Eli Lilly stock has gained 6.3%, while the S&P 500 fell 0.7%. The raise was modest and came with a lower earnings forecast, which is why the price chart is worth a look. So does Eli Lilly's price chart agree with management.
